protocol.cache: warm context reused after existing learning visits; no cache clearing

definitions.lcpCandidate: Latest browser-reported candidate by the bounded initial snapshot before scripted input; not a full-lifetime or field LCP.
definitions.observedCls: Maximum session sum of non-recent-input shifts, gap <1s and session <5s, in this top-level document's observation window.
definitions.layoutAttribution: Up to five browser-exposed sources per shift, fixed region labels and numerical viewport rectangles; source nodes are impacted elements, not proof of the initiating cause. Snapshot geometry includes font-loading status, without DOM text or URLs.
definitions.navigation: Browser document Navigation Timing relative to timeOrigin, not API server processing time; period switches are same-document updates, not new document navigations.
definitions.periodLatency: Browser click event timestamp to the second animation frame after fixture-correct new-period DOM; includes API/render work, not an actual paint timestamp or INP.
definitions.eventTiming: Raw browser Event Timing, requested durationThreshold=16ms; reported durations have 8ms granularity. Faster events may be absent; absence is not zero latency.
definitions.heap: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage bytes for the inspected JavaScript isolate, without forced GC; not process RSS or a leak/long-duration stability claim.

inp.reason: Three finite scripted page visits do not establish page-lifetime or field INP. Event Timing samples are retained separately.

limitations: One CI browser/viewport, warm cache, no CPU/network throttling, two-submission fixture.
Small dependent samples do not establish population p95/p99, device-wide performance or before/after improvement.
Observers and DOM checks add measurement overhead; late paints/shifts outside each bounded window are not measured.
Unsupported metrics are null with reasons; functional API/UI assertions remain required without latency pass thresholds.
